1. Please provide the exact steps required to reproduce the issue you're experience with drafts.

I was able to save multiple drafts during a basic test. See screen shot attached. If the issue is reproducible, please create a bug report for it on github linked below.

2. The app doesn't have any spell checker. That is either a feature of your phone or keyboard app.

3. What is the issue with cut-copy-paste in the app? Those features are provided by Android OS, not the app. There is one known issue related to text selection color. A bug report is open for it here.

4. Please explain the conditions, event sequence or reproducible action that leads to emails just disappearing. If it can be reproduced then developers will be able to fix it.

5. What is the share feature your missing. What are you looking for the app to do with docx files? Sharing the file with TB Android should add the file as an attachment in a new message compose window.

Your welcome to make feature suggestions on Mozilla connect where the community can vote on them.

Please file bug reports using the link below. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues
